title: Equivalent XDL graphs derive one canonical activation plan
intended_use: An X-Verse engineer compiles two equivalent normalized XDL graphs and expects one byte-identical canonical activation plan and digest from the Python compiler, the T017 validator, and the C++ decoder.
expected: Both representations compile and decode to one canonical body and digest with deterministic diagnostics.
environment: candidate checkout, offline, Python 3.11+; the whole-system integration measure re-runs the bound case in the assembled X-Verse checkout.
